correct.text: There are four different types of sentences: exclamations, statements, commands and questions.

instruction.text: Select each part of the picture to learn about different types of sentences.

feedback.correct: We use exclamations to get attention, show surprise, or share intense feelings. These types of sentences end with an exclamation mark.
We use questions to ask something. These types of sentences end with a question mark.
We use commands when we want to tell someone to do something. These types of sentences end with a full stop or an exclamation mark.
We use statements when we want to tell a fact or an idea. These are the most common types of sentences and mostly end with a full stop.
